correctness.rationale: For every 0<tau_1<tau_2 and Delta_i>0, differentiation reduces stationary frequencies to intersections of J_q with a positive level; the exact logarithmic derivative has quadratic sign factor P_q=3qx^2-(q+1)x+3 and positive denominator. Its discriminant proves the unique universal critical q_c=17+12sqrt(2) and, for q>q_c, the necessary-and-sufficient open strength wedge. The inversion J_q(x)J_q(1/(qx))=1 verifies reciprocal endpoints; an integral across the two critical points yields the 3/2 cusp and explicit coefficient with controlled Taylor remainder. A hyperbolic-secant representation verifies the quartic merger and balanced-strength peak positions. Exact symbolic computations and selected root counts in embedded check_resolution.py corroborate, not replace, the global proof. Noise, finite bandwidth, other relaxation mechanisms and fit uniqueness are unproved and excluded.

originality.rationale: Prior Debye formula and physical overlapping processes are explicitly credited. Došla (2009) states general derivative-ratio modality criteria, a genuine broad predecessor, including special logistic (sech-squared), Cauchy and other mixtures. No inspected full primary work states the quantitatively specialized unsquared hyperbolic-secant two-Debye result: exact threshold rho_c=3+2sqrt(2), rational reciprocal strength wedge, quartic merger and numerical 3/2 cusp coefficient. Her general theorem suggests how to approach modality but requires deriving these nontrivial kernel-specific constants and expansions. Overlap of statements/implications, not names, was assessed against general-theorem scope, physical applications, source tables and accessible prior records; unsearched specialized prior analyses remain a real priority risk.

value.rationale: Double relaxation spectra can have one observable maximum even when both positive relaxation components are present. The universal minimum time-scale separation factor 3+2sqrt(2), complete reciprocal strength interval, flat quartic collision, and sharp three-halves opening quantify when two ideal relaxation processes are resolvable in frequency. This is a full physically motivated phase diagram, not an arbitrary slice or merely rederivation of the generic two-mixture modality criterion. Finite-band, noisy experimental resolution and non-Debye mechanisms are expressly outside scope.
